# Auto-generated by convert_to_universal_chart.py — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
# ROOT app-of-apps: the ONE object you apply by hand. It is .txt so that
# nothing applying this directory (ArgoCD included) ever picks it up; kubectl
# reads it fine when the file is named explicitly. Bootstrapping is:
#
#     kubectl apply -f output/rootApplication.yaml.txt
#
# and nothing else. It deploys rootApplicationSet.yaml (and, under
# --cluster-scoped, cluster-shared-application.yaml) by name; everything
# after that reconciles from git. Adding a namespace or a microservice
# later is a git commit, not another apply.
#
# prune is false on purpose: pruning the root ApplicationSet would cascade
# into deleting every Application it generated and every workload those
# deploy. See build_root_application's docstring.

  labels:

  namespace: argocd

  source:
    directory:
      include: '{rootApplicationSet.yaml,cluster-shared-application.yaml}'
      recurse: false
    path: .
    repoURL: https://github.com/devops-ezrahi/universal-chart-example-grouped.git
    targetRevision: main
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: false
      selfHeal: true
    syncOptions:
    - ServerSideApply=true
